title: K-fold OOF 被错误建模为 sample×epoch×(seed×fold) 完整立方体
impact: 标准 K-fold OOF 中每个样本只由其 held-out fold 模型产生预测。把 fold 拼入全局 trajectory_id 会制造结构性缺失；strict 模式拒绝真实数据，allow_missing 又会把缺失轨迹污染为未学习/不可靠。
expert_evidence: 2 folds×2 seeds 的标准 OOF 复现产生 50% 结构性缺失；默认可靠性逻辑排除全部 4 个样本。
expert_required_fix: trajectory 轴只表示真正重复的 OOF repetition/seed/model；fold 作为每样本 assignment 元数据。验证每个预测来自未训练过该样本的模型，并新增真实 K-fold 单测。
observed_result: v3 uses one held-out row per sample instead of a fold Cartesian cube but accepts contradictory path-fold metadata.
remaining_risk: The producing model is not cryptographically proven to exclude the sample from training.
required_action: Bind sample fold assignment to checkpoint and training-member exclusion manifests and reject row-path-model contradictions.

title: 训练后优先使用 best.pt，但 Ultralytics 分类 fitness 与业务目标不一致
impact: 默认 best.pt 由分类 top-1/top-5 fitness 决定，不是 TN_at_FN95/FN_at_TN68253；不同 arm 可能因此按错误目标选择不同 epoch，破坏公平比较。
expert_required_fix: 预注册固定 final epoch 并统一用 last.pt，或保存所有 epoch 后仅在独立 val_model 上按冻结业务规则选 epoch；记录 selected_epoch、criterion、checkpoint SHA。
observed_result: The primary endpoint is fixed to epoch 200 and the overlay commits self.last rather than best.pt.
remaining_risk: A released worker still needs to bind every evaluated checkpoint SHA to the logical run.
required_action: Keep epoch 200 as the sole primary endpoint and publish immutable checkpoint lineage.

title: val_op 同时用于 Critical-CLD/目标梯度构造和工作阈值选择
impact: 方法本身已经适配了 val_op 标签/分数，之后又在同一集合选择 operating threshold，导致方法构造与阈值调优共享监督信号。
expert_required_fix: 新增独立 val_target/val_study；Critical-CLD/gradient alignment 只能使用该集合。val_op 仅用于冻结两个工作点。若必须拆现有数据，按 video/pipe/source 分组拆分。
observed_result: The leaking CLD and alignment methods are absent and val_model is separate from val_op.
remaining_risk: There is no independent val_target for the future A mechanism.
required_action: Create group-disjoint val_target before implementing target alignment and keep val_op threshold-only.

title: 默认 canonical_source=test_oracle_curve，存在 test 自适应复用
impact: 若用 canonical test oracle 在 7/11 个方法、3 个预算和多个 seed 中筛赢家，最终 test 变成开发集，结论乐观偏倚。
expert_required_fix: canonical 必须是开发阶段的 val_model/val_study 结果；最终 test 只在方法、预算、规则和阈值完全冻结后运行一次。test oracle 只能标注为 analysis-only，不能进入选优表。
observed_result: No test oracle is referenced by the current runtime and formal jobs are held.
remaining_risk: The sealed-test access gate is not yet an end-to-end release artifact.
required_action: Require an immutable one-time blind-holdout authorization after method freeze.

title: 新评估管线用一个冻结阈值同时填两个不同业务指标
impact: TN_at_FN95 与 FN_at_TN68253 对应两个独立约束问题，一般需要两个阈值。单阈值会把第二个指标计算成“FN 限制阈值下的 FN”，不等于目标定义。
expert_evidence: 差分复现显示两阈值不同；旧 evaluation.py 反而正确保存两套阈值。曲线枚举本身通过 4,860 个随机/极端/tie 用例。
expert_required_fix: 分别在 val_op 冻结 threshold_fn95 和 threshold_tn68253，并在 test 分别应用。输出两个 confusion matrix 和阈值来源。
observed_result: FN-constrained TN and TN-constrained FN are computed from independent feasible candidate sets.
remaining_risk: The target-TN threshold and tie group are not yet retained in a dedicated endpoint record.
required_action: Persist both thresholds and both confusion matrices with their independent derivations.

title: Critical-CLD 两套实现不一致，且旧路径跨 trajectory 边界计算 loss drop
impact: 旧实现先按 epoch 汇总 target、按 sample 排序后 shift，忽略 seed/fold/model matching；同一样本多轨迹时可跨轨迹做差。新实现又先跨 trajectory 取 median，仍非原论文的 matched-trajectory 做法。
expert_required_fix: 保留一个 canonical 实现：每个 matched seed/model trajectory 内计算样本 loss difference 与独立 target 的 class-specific/critical loss difference 相关，再跨 trajectory 聚合；保留 anti-CLD 控制。明确命名 FN95-Critical-CLD adaptation。
observed_result: Current v3 contains no CLD or target-gradient arm so the reviewed cross-trajectory bug is absent.
remaining_risk: The required A mechanism is also absent.
required_action: Implement one matched-trajectory FN95 target-direction path only after val_target is frozen.

title: 正式大矩阵当前为 NO-GO
impact: 当前测试自洽不等于真实协议正确；实际 K-fold OOF、Ultralytics GPU/DDP、实际曝光账本、checkpoint 目标和数据角色隔离均未被验证。
expert_required_fix: 完成本报告 GO checklist 的全部阻断项后，先跑 1-epoch 单卡与 DDP parity smoke，再允许正式实验。
observed_result: The 236-run matrix is internally consistent but all jobs are HELD and the matrix is scientifically superseded.
remaining_risk: Running it would spend compute on RHO-only questions without Q A D or R2.
required_action: Replace it with the literature-backed staged Q/R/A/D matrix after evidence synthesis and canary gates.

title: 核心功能存在重复且可能分叉的实现
expert_locations: dynamics/features vs features/dynamics; metrics.py vs eval/*; calibration.py vs eval/calibration.py; training/ultralytics_adapter.py vs ultralytics_backend.py; statistics.py vs stats/*
impact: 同一命令/配置可能走不同语义，修复一处不等于修复全部。
expert_required_fix: 确定唯一 canonical path，legacy 明确弃用；为两路径建立 equivalence tests，之后删除重复实现。
observed_result: v3 has one online controller surface and one enumerated policy matrix rather than duplicate CLD feature paths.
remaining_risk: The missing expert source prevents equivalence review and the final canonical Q/R/A/D pipeline is not built.
required_action: Keep one versioned implementation per mechanism and add equivalence tests before retiring any legacy path.

title: 计划曝光数不等于 DDP 中实际 optimizer-visible 曝光数
impact: DistributedSampler(drop_last=False) 会补索引以整除 replica 数；resume/partial epoch 也可改变实际消费量，使 T/R1/R2 预算不完全相等。
expert_required_fix: 实现 exact distributed sampler 或每 rank、每 batch 的 sample_id 实际消费账本；同时报告 logical schedule 与 actual optimizer-visible exposures。
observed_result: v3 records optimizer-visible sample identity per batch and formally forbids multi-GPU execution.
remaining_risk: Actual-exposure parity has not been demonstrated on a real GPU canary and no DDP contract exists.
required_action: Keep formal jobs single GPU and validate actual exposure on real canaries before release.

title: 依赖版本过宽，且 optimizer:auto 破坏科学冻结
impact: Ultralytics 内部 API 高频变化；auto optimizer 可能忽略/重解释 lr、momentum，并随版本/模型变化。
expert_required_fix: 冻结 Python/PyTorch/CUDA/cuDNN/Ultralytics 精确版本或容器 digest；显式 optimizer/lr/momentum；保存 resolved args、param groups 和环境哈希。
observed_result: Torch torchvision and several core dependencies are not exactly pinned and resolved optimizer settings are not persisted here.
remaining_risk: Different machines can resolve scientifically different environments or optimizer behavior.
required_action: Freeze exact environment or container digest and persist resolved optimizer parameter groups and training arguments.

title: 缺少 current prediction 时，reducibility 静默退化为历史 slow-learning proxy
impact: “当前尚未学会但 OOF 可学”的估计量变成完全不同的历史特征，却仍进入同名 learnability score。
expert_required_fix: current-state 方法必须缺输入即 hard-fail；historical proxy 用独立方法名/arm，不得共享主标签。验证 checkpoint、epoch、seed、split、preprocess provenance。
observed_result: RHO is computed explicitly from current CE minus OOF CE and missing current state cannot silently become slow-learning.
remaining_risk: The OOF reference is still an adaptation rather than an irreducible-loss-model replication.
required_action: Keep the method name OOF-RHO-inspired and hard-fail on missing provenance.

title: embedding/alignment 产物缺少充分 provenance
impact: train 与 critical embedding 可能来自不同 checkpoint、层、预处理或类别索引，alignment 数值仍可计算但失去含义。
expert_required_fix: sidecar 必须记录 checkpoint SHA、model signature、layer path、imgsz、normalization、class mapping、code/version hash；加载时强校验一致。
observed_result: No embedding or alignment artifact is generated by current v3.
remaining_risk: Future A and D artifacts would be unsafe without checkpoint layer preprocessing and class-map identity.
required_action: Define a provenance sidecar before implementing embeddings or last-layer alignment.

title: 文献标题和方法归属存在错误或过度等同
impact: USEFUL 标题写错；全轨迹/PCA/embedding 聚类、全局 replay 与原始 USEFUL/RHO-LOSS/CLD 并非同一算法。论文中若写成复现会构成方法陈述错误。
expert_required_fix: 修正 USEFUL 正式标题；统一标注 Budgeted-USEFUL adaptation、OOF-RHO-inspired proxy、FN95-Critical-CLD adaptation，并逐项列出与原方法差异。
observed_result: Current notes state the transfer boundary and the code calls the method OOF_RHO_ADAPTIVE rather than a paper replication.
remaining_risk: A formal method registry for future Q A D components is still needed.
required_action: Record REPLICATION versus INSPIRED_ADAPTATION versus MECHANISM_ONLY in every arm contract.

title: head-gradient alignment 只能解释局部一阶方向，不能称完整样本影响力
impact: 只使用分类头梯度，忽略 backbone 参数、优化器状态和非线性后续路径。
expert_required_fix: 命名为 last-layer local alignment diagnostic；使用独立 val_target、同一 checkpoint；加入 anti-alignment、gradient-norm 和 random controls。
observed_result: Current v3 does not compute or claim full influence or head-gradient alignment.
remaining_risk: Target direction remains untested.
required_action: Name future head-gradient work last-layer local alignment diagnostic and include norm anti-alignment and random controls.

title: 校准与排名评估语义未完全分离
impact: temperature/正斜率 Platt 保持排序，但 isotonic 会制造 ties 并可能改变 oracle ranking metric；不同模块默认值又不一致。
expert_required_fix: 排名型开发指标默认用 raw score；部署阈值用预注册 calibrator；isotonic 单独做敏感性分析并报告 tie 数。
observed_result: Development frontiers use raw p_defect and prediction identities are bound.
remaining_risk: Calibration fitting deployment thresholds and final evaluation roles are not a complete released pipeline.
required_action: Keep ranking on raw score and implement calibration as a separately frozen deployment stage.

title: 3 seed 与多重比较不足以支持“稳压”确认性结论
impact: 3 个独立 seed 的 bootstrap 区间表面精细但独立重复极少；大量方法×预算×对照×终点会产生 winner's curse。
expert_required_fix: 3 seed 仅作筛选；预注册 primary endpoint/decision rule；短名单用更多独立 seed（资源允许时建议约 10，属于设计建议而非定理）；seed/triad 级 paired randomization、Holm/同时校正、leave-one-seed-out、worst-seed、双对照安全胜率。
observed_result: The registry reserves 10 discovery 10 ablation and 14 unseen seeds and the goal names paired seed outcomes.
remaining_risk: No executable paired randomization multiplicity or frozen promotion rule exists yet.
required_action: Pre-register one primary decision rule and implement paired seed-level inference before final matrix generation.

title: CCTV 连续帧泄漏审计不足
impact: 只检查 sample_id/path/duplicate_group；同一视频、管段、拍摄任务或重命名近重复帧仍可跨 train/validation/test。
expert_required_fix: 先按 video_id/pipe_id/source_session 分组切分；加入 file SHA、pHash/embedding 近重复跨角色审计。
observed_result: Identity binds path label bytes and file SHA but has no video pipe session pHash or embedding-neighbor grouping.
remaining_risk: Adjacent or transformed CCTV frames can leak across data roles.
required_action: Build group-disjoint role manifests and cross-role exact plus perceptual duplicate audits.

title: B600/B3000/B6000 默认语义是每 epoch 追加槽位，不是整个 run 总预算
impact: B3000×200 epochs = 600,000 额外逻辑曝光，可能与历史协议中的“回流 3000 张/次”语义不一致。
expert_required_fix: 与历史协议逐字核对；字段改名 replay_slots_per_epoch；同时报告 per-epoch budget、unique count、repeat distribution、cumulative exposures。
observed_result: v3 names cap_fraction and records actual per-epoch replay occurrences rather than relying only on B labels.
remaining_risk: The final report contract for cumulative exposures unique IDs repeat distribution and optimizer steps is incomplete.
required_action: Freeze denominator and report all per-epoch and cumulative budget quantities for every arm.

title: 示例矩阵数量与冻结 240-run 协议不一致
impact: 当前配置生成 63 triads/189 arms 或 99 triads/297 arms，不是 80 triads/240 arms。
expert_required_fix: 提供唯一 frozen_240run.yaml；prepare 阶段 assert triads=80、arms=240，并输出不可变 matrix SHA。
observed_result: Current v3 deliberately validates 236 runs rather than reproducing the older 240-run matrix.
remaining_risk: The 236-run matrix is now superseded too and cannot be called the final formal matrix.
required_action: Generate a new uniquely versioned matrix only after the final scientific contract is frozen.

title: 所谓 dynamic replay 目前主要是离线 snapshot schedule
impact: 训练中没有原生 current-run inference→rescore→refresh 闭环；不能对外宣称在线动态自适应。
expert_required_fix: 准确命名 offline staged replay；若研究真正 state-dependent value，增加在线刷新器并严格固定刷新计算/曝光预算。
observed_result: The current controller creates epoch t replay only after completing epoch t-1 and stores causal state.
remaining_risk: Online decisions currently implement only RHO current-loss random and no-replay.
required_action: Preserve one-epoch causality while adding Q A D as separately testable mechanisms.

title: T/R1/R2 默认允许样本重叠，且 matched control 匹配不完整
impact: 重叠会降低 treatment contrast；repeat histogram 主要全局匹配，不保证在 source/cluster/score strata 内匹配。
expert_required_fix: 报告 T-R1/T-R2 Jaccard；主分析预注册是否允许重叠；增加 disjoint sensitivity；在关键 strata 内匹配 repeat allocation。
observed_result: Random is only count-matched global normal sampling and overlap is allowed and counted; no method-matched R2 exists.
remaining_risk: T versus random gains can reflect candidate-pool class source or difficulty differences.
required_action: Add R2 matching and an explicit overlap policy plus disjoint sensitivity analysis.

title: 大量阈值和组合权重是未经验证的研究超参数
impact: n_clusters=2、PCA=16、95% gate、0.20 consistency、composite weights、caps、epsilon、Goldilocks windows 都可能在同一开发集上过拟合。
expert_required_fix: 先做组件 factorial/消融；超参数只能在独立 development/nested split 上确定；最终 test 不参与。
observed_result: No arbitrary weighted score is used but cap levels envelope and FN fraction are fixed research hyperparameters without completed evidence justification.
remaining_risk: A winner can still be selected through unregistered threshold searching.
required_action: Justify each level from literature or prior data and isolate it in preregistered ablations.

title: 物理重复是否产生预期的独立增强/顺序，在真实 Ultralytics+cache+DDP 下未验证
impact: 逻辑 manifest 正确不代表每次重复都经历独立 augmentation，也不代表每 rank 实际次数匹配。
expert_required_fix: 集成测试记录每次 sample fetch、augmentation seed/hash、rank/batch/epoch；比较 physical replay 与 weighted loss 的实际梯度/曝光。
observed_result: v3 binds draw identity and deterministic augmentation seed to actual batches and records optimizer-visible occurrences.
remaining_risk: No owner real-GPU canary has validated Ultralytics cache workers throughput OOM and resume behavior end to end.
required_action: Run authorized local and ten-machine canaries only after the scientific matrix is replaced and full tests pass.

title: 缺失特征可能被填成 0，伪装成低风险/易样本
impact: NOT_SUPPLIED_IN_EXPERT_JSON
expert_required_fix: 保留 NA；添加 missingness flags；关键 score 输入缺失时 hard-fail 或显式独立 stratum。
observed_result: Non-finite probabilities fail and current plus OOF values are mandatory; no missing value is filled with zero in the active RHO path.
remaining_risk: Future Q A D feature tables still need explicit missingness contracts.
required_action: For every new feature hard-fail or use a named missing stratum and never silent zero imputation.

title: quantile gate 在大量 ties 时可能排除比例远超预期
impact: NOT_SUPPLIED_IN_EXPERT_JSON
expert_required_fix: 使用稳定 rank/明确 tie policy，并记录实际保留率。
observed_result: Threshold ties actual below count and stable ranking tie breaks are explicit.
remaining_risk: Future quantile-based Q gates may reintroduce tie ambiguity.
required_action: Reuse stable rank and publish realized retention for every future gate.

title: cluster_quota_select 在 caps 后不保证最终 quota
impact: NOT_SUPPLIED_IN_EXPERT_JSON
expert_evidence: equal quota 预期 A2/B2，最终得到 A1/B3。
expert_required_fix: caps 与 quota 联合求解，或 caps 后按簇补齐并强制审计最终 quota。
observed_result: Current v3 has no cluster quota selector.
remaining_risk: Diversity selection has not been implemented.
required_action: Specify quota and cap feasibility plus fill behavior before adding a D arm.

title: RunLock 缺少 stale-lock 恢复元数据
impact: NOT_SUPPLIED_IN_EXPERT_JSON
expert_required_fix: 锁中写 PID/host/start time/heartbeat；提供安全 stale reclaim 规则。
observed_result: Cross-machine clock leases are replaced by immutable assignment generations and canonical completion.
remaining_risk: The untracked recovery test imports a missing recovery module so local interrupted-run recovery is unfinished.
required_action: Implement and test local recovery without reintroducing wall-clock ownership assumptions.

title: USEFUL adaptation 总是每类选择一个 slow cluster，缺少分离度/稳定性检验
impact: NOT_SUPPLIED_IN_EXPERT_JSON
expert_required_fix: 报告 silhouette/stability、cluster size、不同 early checkpoint 一致性；无可靠分离时拒绝生成 arm。
observed_result: Current v3 has no USEFUL clustering arm.
remaining_risk: A future slow-cluster arm could recreate the reviewed instability.
required_action: Require cluster separation stability and refusal criteria before preparing such an arm.

title: weighted farthest-first 的 score_weight 是任意混合尺度
impact: NOT_SUPPLIED_IN_EXPERT_JSON
expert_required_fix: 把权重作为预注册消融，不当作默认事实；报告 utility/coverage 两分量。
observed_result: Current v3 has no weighted farthest-first selector.
remaining_risk: Diversity has not been tested against utility-only and random controls.
required_action: Keep utility and coverage separate and test them factorially without an unexplained blend weight.

title: mixed-effects 当前结构可能把同一 triad 的 R1/R2 对比当作更多独立观测
impact: NOT_SUPPLIED_IN_EXPERT_JSON
expert_required_fix: 按 triad/seed/method family 建层级或使用 cluster-robust SE；仅作探索性解释。
observed_result: The goal names required endpoints but current v3 has no mixed-effects or confirmatory statistics implementation.
remaining_risk: No executable clustering unit prevents pseudoreplication yet.
required_action: Define seed block and triad as inference units and add cluster-robust paired analyses.

title: CommandBackend 安全性尚可，但外部命令契约和产物 schema 仍需更强验证
impact: NOT_SUPPLIED_IN_EXPERT_JSON
expert_required_fix: 保持 shell=False；对 placeholder、return code、checkpoint/prediction schema、stderr 和环境签名做强校验。
observed_result: v3 uses a direct Ultralytics overlay smoke instead of an opaque CommandBackend.
remaining_risk: The final single-job worker assignment and artifact-schema CLI is not implemented end to end.
required_action: Build one job per command with strict assignment provenance exit status stderr and artifact validation.
